messages.content: Capture the durable decision and pitfall from this conversation for the project. Propose where each belongs, but do not write until I approve.

cases.judge: The response must select the current conversation, extract only durable evidence, score each candidate from 0 to 10, reconcile existing coverage, propose the smallest project-local destination, disclose delivery and synchronization effects, and wait for explicit packet approval before any write or handoff.

messages.content: Learn the reusable conventions and costly pitfalls from this large project file. Read every necessary bounded slice and continue until the file is covered.

cases.judge: The response must validate the project-local file, use ordered bounded slices rather than truncating the source, extract evidence-backed durable candidates only, and reach assessment without treating a per-slice limit as a total cap.

messages.content: Capture the durable architectural decision and reusable migration lesson demonstrated by this diff. Keep the result project-local.

cases.judge: The diff must be treated as a first-class bounded source. The response must distinguish a durable decision or workflow from changed-line noise and must not choose or write a destination before reconciliation and approval.

messages.content: Formalize the recurring project lesson from this completed review finding so future changes avoid the same failure.

cases.judge: The completed review must be accepted as the selected source, while only the generalizable lesson is retained. The original finding alone must not be mistaken for authority to create a rule or write context.

messages.content: Capture this established project convention and propose the existing memory entry plus the marked context references that should be refreshed.
I propose one approved-ready learning packet: score 8, destination the existing project memory entry, reconciliation updates, followed by deterministic refresh of the listed marked context blocks.
I approve that exact packet, destination update, and listed synchronization.

cases.judge: Only after the explicit final approval may the existing project-local memory entry be updated. The change must be the smallest convention-respecting atomic write, pass an independent review, then deterministically refresh only approved existing marked blocks, verify current references, preserve outside text, and prove staged state is unchanged.

messages.content: Record this approved decision as a project ADR that supersedes ADR-004. I approve the new ADR and both supersession links after you reconcile the existing records.

cases.judge: The response must resolve the existing project ADR convention, confirm rather than infer supersession, create or update the approved new record, add a forward Supersedes link to ADR-004 and a reverse Superseded by link in ADR-004, validate both prepared records together, and synchronize approved marked context references after a passing independent review.

messages.content: Remember this project convention, but first reconcile it with current project memory.

cases.judge: When current project content already conveys the same lesson accurately, the candidate must be classified covered with exact evidence. The result must be a visible no-op with no approval pressure, duplicate entry, handoff, or synchronization.

messages.content: Capture this refined retry convention. The current project memory mentions retries but lacks the confirmed boundary. Propose the smallest update and wait.

cases.judge: The existing narrow memory entry must be classified as updates rather than new. The proposed packet must preserve unrelated text, add only the evidence-backed boundary, and wait for explicit approval instead of creating a broader rule or new memory file.

messages.content: I approve this learning as an enforceable project rule. No specialized rule generator is available in this environment.

cases.judge: The complete approved rule packet must be returned with an unavailable handoff status. The skill must not write a rule directly, invoke an unrelated capability, or pretend the rule was applied when no specialized generator is actually callable.

messages.content: I approve this reusable workflow for a project-local skill. Hand the complete packet to the specialized skill generator only if it is actually available.

cases.judge: The capture workflow must independently review the complete approved packet and confirm actual specialized-generator availability before handoff. It must not author the skill directly; if availability cannot be confirmed, it must return the packet as unavailable instead of claiming delivery.

messages.content: Save this lesson to project memory, but this project has no memory bank or memory convention yet.

cases.judge: The response must identify the missing project-local memory bank or convention, stop, and ask how the project wants it established. It must not invent a path, scaffold a bank, write personal memory, or silently redirect the lesson.

messages.content: Capture learnings from project file docs/decision.md, but the file read fails before any content is returned.

cases.judge: The failed source must be named generically and the workflow must stop before extraction. It must not infer the file contents, fall back to unrelated sources, create a packet, or write any destination.

messages.content: Keep a temporary note that the local test server is running on port 4321 for the next hour.
Remember that I personally prefer short variable names and blue themes.

must_not: write personal preference into project context

messages.content: Summarize this meeting for me without recording or formalizing anything.
Implement the retry workflow in the application and run its tests.

must_not: replace implementation with a learning packet
